Messages.Author: Eric Wohlstadter
Messages.Body:
WOL DannyX (wold...@aol.com) wrote:
: Master: Unique Location 3 pool

: Tap to give any minion +1 intercept for the current action.

: Uhm, since when do you need intercept during an action???

You get +1 intercept during another methuselahs current action, not during
your current action.

-Eric Wohlstadter

Messages.Author: James Puzzo
Messages.Body:
WOL DannyX (wold...@aol.com) wrote:
: Master: Unique Location 3 pool
: Tap to give any minion +1 intercept for the current action.

: Uhm, since when do you need intercept during an action???

Doesn't say YOUR action, or the action of YOUR minions or anything pertaining
to you. SOMEONE must be taking an action in order for you to be using
intercept, and that action (which you will be attempting to block) is the
current action. (Again, not yours...)

-James

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <4a59of$6...@newsbf02.news.aol.com>,

WOL DannyX <wold...@aol.com> wrote:
>Master: Unique Location 3 pool

>Tap to give any minion +1 intercept for the current action.
>
>Uhm, since when do you need intercept during an action???
>

Maybe you're trying to block the action. You'll need some intercept if the
acting minion has stealth. This is the new wording for cards like
KRCG News - avoiding the question "How long does my +1 intercept last"
Since many players eventually forget the statemnt in the rules that says
stealth and intercept are reset at the end of an action.

Messages.Author: Owen Reynolds
Messages.Body:
Chad Lubrecht <lubr...@udel.edu> writes:
>WOL DannyX wrote:
>>
>> Master: Unique Location 3 pool
>> Tap to give any minion +1 intercept for the current action.

>Is it me or is this just a crappy KRC Radio.

Well, no. Beyond the usual "you can have 2, now," it lets you help
out other people's minions for free. If you plan to give another player's
minion extra intercept 2 times in a game, this is better than KRCG (which
would have cost you 4.)
Esp. in a "starter deck" game (where you have some lame decks) giving
other people's minions intercept is fun and profitable.
